reasons: harness.py:act() decides only from obs['text']['long_term_context'] parsed by parse_glyph_map (message / language observation / cursor / map). There are no reads of env internals, full_state, oracle fields, seeds or task ids anywhere in harness.py (grep for full_state|oracle|seed finds nothing). tools/ is absent.

The decision chain is reflexes (prompt more/esc, down on a drawn '>', swing at an adjacent letter), then a BFS chart route over drawn cells (route()), then a per-episode TD value learner that consults the model on ties. All of its state is built from observed glyphs, prose clauses and bump messages, and it clears on reset() and on a Dlvl change. There are no lookup tables and no per-instance branching.

Model-free steps go through reply(), which returns LLMResponse(model_id='harness', input_tokens=0, output_tokens=0, reasoning=<rung>). They are labelled honestly, not presented as model calls. consult() calls the real client.generate on the stock prompt. Trace tallies agree with the code: chart:route 1377, learner:argmax 638, learner:consult 187, reflex:swing 115, reflex:more 15.
There is no interaction with the scorer or evaluator. Every action is a legal-vocabulary string returned to the normal env.step loop.
